objective: Bring 30 Coyote Jawbones to Neeka Bloodscar in Kargath.

description: Have you spent many days in the Badlands, <class>?  Have you felt its heat? Have you faced the beasts that wander its dusty plains?  It's time you did.
Crag coyotes are a tough breed.  Tough, and bold enough to creep into Kargath and steal from our food supplies.  Help rid the outpost of these thieves!
Hunt crag coyotes, <name>.  Hunt them and bring me their jawbones.  Bring me enough, and maybe I'll believe it when you say you know the Badlands.
completion: That's a nice collection of jawbones, <name>. Now those coyotes won't be tearing through our supplies for scraps.
Well done. The coyotes of the Badlands aren't easy prey. Your deed shows me that you might just survive here.
